home.eyebrow: Bishigendagwad · Gaawin adaawewinan · Gaawin ozhibii'igewin · Gaawin diba'igaansan maagizhaa dibaakonigewin
home.h1: Mino-odaminowinan miinawaa Inakamigiziwinan ondaje Bemaadizijig Wenji-waninaagoziwaad
home.lede: Nenahii mazinaakizigan-odaminowinan, nitaa-waabandamingin mazinaatesijiganan, miinawaa inakamigiziwinan ji-mino-wiidoopamaadawaad—weweni ezhi-gashkitoodwaad.
facts: Pooniton aaniin apii go; gaawin gegoo gidaa-bwaanawi'osiin
home.heroApp: Miinawaa bishigendaagwad aabajichigan ondaje iPhone, iPad miinawaa Android, gidoodem mazinaakiziganan aabajitoodwaad

steps.title: Onandan gegoo gaa-nitaa-gikendaman
steps.text: Mazinaakiziganan aniibiishaabo-onaagansag, gitigaanag, awesiinyag miinawaa jiimaanensag. Gaawin agindamowin maagizhaa onaakonigewinan ji-gikinoo'amaagooyan nitam.

steps.title: Wiijibimok
steps.text: Bagaakoshkanawaa. Dibaajimok mazinaakiziganing. Giishpin baakaan naagwak, anishaa bibaa-bii'on ji-tangining miinawaa.

steps.title: Pooniton megwaa mino-ayaayan
steps.text: Bezhig odaminowin miziwe inakamigad. “Mii sa i'iw noongom” apane naagwad mazinaabikiigang.

home.stageLede: Madwewechigan, endaso-giizhig anokiiwinan, mikwendamowinan miinawaa bekaadakamigad mino-ayaawin, aanzhichigaade weweni ji-mino-inendaming noongom.

stages.title: Maajitaa-apii
stages.text: Ayaangwaamitoon gaa-zaagitoodwaad, bangii go aanzhichigaadeg: mino-anokiiwinan, gojiing izhaawin, ikidowin-odaminowinan miinawaa maamawi-inendamowin.
stages.label: Maajitaa-apii inendamowinan

stages.title: Naawii-apii
stages.text: Nenahii, nitaa-doodamowinan bibaaninjigaadegin: dagonigan, maawanji'igan, madwewechigan, mazinaakizigan-odaminowinan miinawaa akozi-bimoseng.
stages.label: Naawii-apii inendamowinan

stages.title: Baanimaa-apii
stages.text: Mino-inendamowin miinawaa wiidoopamowin tanginidiwining, noondaagwazing miinawaa waabandaming: oninji-ganawenindiwin, gaa-zaagitoodwaad nagamowinan, mazinaakiziganan miinawaa anishaa maamawi-ayaang.
stages.label: Baanimaa-apii inendamowinan

home.specificHtml: Ginanandawendaan ina gegoo gaa-aanjisichigaadeg? Nandawaabandan inakamigiziwinan miinawaa odaminowinan ondaje Alzheimer's, mino-mikwendaasowin odaminowinan, nenahii gakwedwewinan maagizhaa puzzles.
home.approachLede: Miziwe “gidinendamowin-odaminowinan” ozhichigaadewan dadatabiwining, diba'iganing miinawaa debanaming. Ondaje a'aw wenji-waninaagozid gidaa-inaabandam gakwedwewining ezhinaagwak. Niinawind baakaan gwayak nindozhitoomin.

principles.title: Gaawin gegoo gidaa-bwaanawi'osiin
principles.text: Gaawin diba'igiiziswan, diba'igan, bimaadiziwinan maagizhaa wanitowin. Baakaan mazinaakizigan anishaa booni-ayaawin, gaawin wanise-doodamowin.

principles.title: Mazinaakiziganan apane naagwadoon
principles.text: Gikendamowin ani-waabandaming, gaawin go nandawenjigaadenzinoon ji-mikwendaming. Gwayak maajisigaade daashki-naagwakin, mii wenji-gaawin gegoo mikwendamowin aabadasinoon.

principles.title: Gichi-aya'aa miinawaa manazomaagan
principles.text: Gizhaate, nenahii ikidowinan miinawaa gwayak-aki mazinaakiziganan. Gaawin wikaa abinoojiinh-mazinaabikiing maagizhaa binoojiing giigidowin.

principles.title: Gimodiziwin nitaa-gikendaagwad
principles.text: Gaawin ozhibii'igewi-mazina'igan maagizhaa adaawewinan. Gimazinaakiziganan gaawin wikaa da-maajaamagasinoon omaa gidaabajichiganing.

guides.title: Ezhi-maamawi-odaminong
guides.text: Ezhi-ozhichigaadeg, dadatabiwin, miinawaa ge-doodamang giishpin odaminowin poonigad minwendaming.

guides.title: Apii gaawiin ikidowaad inakamigiziwining
guides.text: Nitaa-inendamoog wenji-aazhidewendangig, miinawaa bishigendaagwad ezhi-gashkitoong baanimaa miinawaa.

guides.title: Ezhi-wewenizichigaadeg tablet
guides.text: Mangizhibii'igan, bangii go giiwashkwewezhiganan miinawaa bezhig nenahii oshki-mazina'igan.

guides.title: Bishigendagwadoon inakamigiziwinan ge-ozhibii'igaadegin
guides.text: Mangi-ikidowin nandawaabandamowinan, zhooshkwaabikiziganan, bingo miinawaa ganoonidiwi-mazina'igaansan.

home.researchText: Gidaa-naganaawaa na waninaagoziwin? O-wiidookawin na gidinendamowin-odaminowinan? Aaniin dash bagidinigewin, miijim, nibawin miinawaa noondamowin? Nenahii gwayak nakwewinan dibaajimowinang, miinawaa aandi gwayak gaa-zoongisinoog.

faq.a: Minwaa naadamaagewinan ezhi-ayaawaad: bangii, gaa-ayaawaad, aanawaa dakoniwin. Mazinaakanan miinwaa mazinaigan waabandamaan, nangwaakaajigewin, miinwaa dibaajimowinan gaa-ganawendang. Giga-naadamaagewin minwaa niibiwendam. Gaawiin ayaawaan zhaagodaadiwin, anamiijigewin, miinwaa ganaajiwin.

Ahaaw. Gaawiin ginoodaagewin naadamaagewinan miinwaa gaawiin akawe ayaawaad Golden Moments wiinzaan. Naadamaagewinan ezhi-bimaadiziwaad nibiiwaabikoniwin web-browser ezhi-wiindamaang: phone, tablet, aanawaa computer.

Gaawiin naadamaagewin gaa-wiindamaagoyin dementia ezhi-gaagiigidoonan, miinwaa Golden Moments gaawiin ezhi-dibaajimo ezhi-waabandamaan, ezhi-gaagiigidoonan. Naadamaagewinan ezhi-mino-bimaadiziwin miinwaa giigoonh wiijiiwaad. Aanawaa dibaajimowin dibaajimowinan nibiiwaabikoniwin noongom wiindamaagenan.

Ahaaw. Alzheimer's dementia-wan gaa-ayaad apii, miinwaa naadamaagewinan ezhi-ayaawaad: mazinaigan gaa-ayaawaad, miijigeyaang, miinwaa gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaawaad wiijiiwaad. Mikwendaagozi naadamaagewin, nangwaakaajigewin, miinwaa dibaajimowinan gaa-ganawendang gaa-izhi-mawidiwaad.

Gaaweyaa, wiijiiwag ezhi-ayaad. Mazinaakanan Find the same miinwaa Picture pairs gaa-ayaad, aanawaa mazinaigan miinwaa anishinaabe ginoodaagewin. Ezhi-gii-naadamaagewin giiwenh, miinwaa miigwechiwiyaa ezhi-maajiigaadeg.

Site ayaawaad gaawiin akawe ayaawaad miinwaa gaawiin nakamowin. Google Analytics ezhi-giiwenh ezhi-nibiiwaabikoniwin mashkiiwaad. Mazinaigan Photo pairs gaa-ginoodaagewin giishpin browser-ayaawaad, gaawiin ezhi-ganawendang.
Golden Moments gaa-ayaad ayaawaad, miinwaa naadamaagewinan ezhi-ayaawaad web miinwaa free app-ayaad. Gaawiin ayaawaan dibaajimowin, miinwaa gaawiin zhaagodaadiwin.

about.title: Wiijiiwaad Naadamaagewin, Gaawiin Nibiiwaabikoniwin
about.description: Golden Moments naadamaagewinan gaawiin zhaagodaadiwin, gaawiin anamiijigewin, gaawiin nakamowin, mazinaigan gaa-ayaawaad miinwaa gaa-dibaajimowinan dementia gaa-ayaawaad.
about.lede: Golden Moments mashkawiziwin, miinwaa dementia-wan miinwaa wiijiiwaad ezhi-naadamaagewinan ezhi-ayaawaad.
about.bodyHtml:
Ezhi-debweyendamag

Ezhi-gikendaming omaa odaminoowin, mii go eta omaa apii: ganoonidiyang, shoomiingweniyang, minwendaming niizh mazinaabijiganan naasab ategin, maagizhaa gaye besho eta abi-namadabiyang. Gaawiin omaa awiya nanda-gikendamaawisiimin, gaawiin mashkawinaasiin, gaawiin gaye gegoo nanda-waabanda'iwesiimin.

Miziwe nitaa-mazinaabijiganan gaa-onji-ayaagin debwezhinong wii-gagwedinaad odinendamoowin dadatabiwin, agindasowinan, gaye bimi-nitaawichigewin. Awiya wenji-waniikwewizid, maagizhaa ta-inendang gagwedwewin gaa-wiikaa gashkitoosiwen. Niinawind bakaan indizhitwaamin, mii dash owo ezhi-ganawenindizoyang:

  • Gaawiin gegoo gaa-gashkitoosinoon. Gaawiin diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowin, anzaabidising, bimaadiziwin-agindasowin, maagizhaa agindaasowin omaa mazinaakateyag.
  • Nisidotamowin apane miziwe. Mazinaabijiganan ategojin apane. Ganoonidiiwinan onji-ayaawan, gaawiin wiikaa awiya gagwedwe-anokiitaasii ge-izhiniikaazod maagizhaa ge-mikwendang.
  • Michaag, biindig, gaye bekaajiwag. Gichi-ozhibii'iganan gaye mazinaabijiganan, baasikaag gaa-waabang, gaye aabajichiganan naasab apane ebiigeyag.
  • Gichi-aya'aa manaji'idizowin. Debwewin-mazinaabijiganan gaye gizhewaadizi-ikidowinan. Gaawiin cartoon-mazinaateseg, gaawiin nikaamo-mino-wiindamaagewin, gaawiin gaye bimi-miijiganan.
  • Weweni ishkwataawin. “Ishkwaataang noongom” apane naagwad. Aabita-anokiiyang poonendaming, mii go gaye gichi-mino-giiwe-izhitwaawin.
  • Giigido-gimooji-ganawendaming. Gaawiin ozhibii'igamig, gaawiin gaye adaawewin-mazinaatesegin. Gidaa-mazinaabijiganan gaa-onandamowad ategojin omaa gidoozhibii'igaasining.

Gaa-wiikaa indikitosiimin

Gidodaminoowininaanin onji-ayaawan minwendamowin gaye maamawinitowin. Gaawiin o-mashkawisiinoon, gaawiin gagwedwe-inendamoosiinoon, gaawiin diba'amaagewisiinoon, gaawiin noondamii'iwesiinoon, gaawiin gaye gidasigaasinoon waniikwewiziwin maagizhaa Alzheimer’s aakoziwin, gaye gaawiin awiya odoonji-aabajitoosiin owo onji. Apii ozhibii'amag gaa-nandagikendaming omaa mino-inendamowin mazina'iganing, bagak indikitomin aaniindi wenji-anami'e-gashkendaming, gaawiin dash wiikaa indaabaji'aasiimin gidodaminoowininaanin.

Awenenag niinawind

Golden Moments agaasaa maamawi-anokiijig. Gaawiin mushkikiiwininiiwisiimin. Niwii-ozhibii'amaagoom gaa-ozhitoowaad National Institute on Aging gaye Alzheimer’s Association, gaye endaso-mazina'igan ogikendaan wenjibaamagak. Agindan ezhi-ozhibii'amag gaye ezhi-gikendamag nimazina'iganinaan.

Wiindamawishinaam wegonen ge-naadamagak

Niminaadenmaanan wii-noondamag wegonen gaa-mino-segeg gaye gaa-mino-segesinog, memindage omaa bemaadizijig wenji-waniikwewiziwaad, odaanikoobijigan-naadamaagewininiwag, gaye anokiiwininiwag odaminoowining. Mazina'igaans-izhitawishinaam omaa {email}.

editorial.title: Ezhi-ozhibii'amag gaye Ezhi-gikendamag Nimazina'iganinaan
editorial.description: Ezhi-nandagikendang, ezhi-ozhibii'ang, ezhi-mikang, gaye ezhi-oshkitoong Golden Moments odaminoowin gaye mino-inendamowin mazina'iganan waniikwewiziwining onji, gaye gegoo gaa-wiikaa ge-sakamoosinoog.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Wenbii'iganan

Nimaamawi-naadamagoomin gichi-miziwe gaa-ozhibii'igaadeg mamawi National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance, gaye NHS, gaye nandagikendamowin omaa Cochrane reviews gaye gichi-gagwedwewinan. Endaso-mazina'igan owiindamaage wenjibaamagak. Nibaakinamin endaso-mazina'igan gibwaa-wiindamag, gaye mii go eta debwewin ezhinaagwak ninoondamoomin.

Ezhi-ozhibii'amag

  • Gegoo ge-gashkitoong noongom: wegonen ge-dazhiikang noongom, bakaan bagak ikidowining.
  • Gwayakozidizoyang debwewining: indikitomin “wiidookawidimagan”, “ganabaj”, gaye “aanjigiizhwe-gikendamowin” apii gwayakwamigak.
  • Manaji'idizowin: nidozhibii'amaanan bemaadizijig wenji-waniikwewiziwaad ezhi-gichi-aya'aawiyang, gaawiin wiikaa gagwedwe-maashinaagwatoosiimin.
  • Gaawiin gaa-ozhichigaasinoog: gaawiin giiwanimowin-agindasowin, giiwanimo-ikidowin, gichi-gikendangig, nandagikendamoowinan, maagizhaa wiindamaagewinan.

Awenenag gaa-gikendangig nimazina'iganinaan

Mazina'iganan odozhibii'aawaan gaye ogagweji'aawaan Golden Moments anokiijig, wiidookood AI ozhibii'iganan nandagikendaming gaye waawiyebii'igeng. Endaso-mazina'igan gegweji'igaaso ezhi-wenjibaamagak. Nimazina'iganinaan gaawiin omashkikiiwininiwi-gikendanziin, gaawiin gaye indikitosiimin. Mii go eta miziwe-gikendamowin, gaawiin mushkiki-gikendamowin aawansinoon.

Gegoo gaa-wiikaa ge-ozhibii'amaasigang

  • Ikidowinan ge-gashkitoong odaminoowin, miijim, aani-mashkiki, anami'ewin maagizhaa ezhitwaawin wii-gidasigang, wii-noondamii'iweng, wii-bekaajitoong maagizhaa wii-noojimo'ang waniikwewiziwin.
  • Gagwedwe-mazina'iganan maagizhaa agindasowinan gaa-inaabanjigaadeg awiya ayaawaad, maagizhaa ayaasiwaad, waniikwewiziwin.
  • Gagwejimigoowin wii-maajii-aabajitoong, wii-poonitoong maagizhaa wii-aanjitoong mushkiki.
  • Adaawewin-dazhiikeng gaa-gizhiibii'igaadeg ezhi-naadamaagewin.

Oshki-ozhibii'iganan gaye gwayakochigewinan

Endaso-mazina'igan owiindamaage apii gaa-aanjigaadeg. Kishpin mikamawan giiwanimowin maagizhaa mewinzha-mazina'igan, biindigen omaa {email} gaye wewiib ninga-gagweji'aamin.

faq.title: Gagwedwewinan gaye Nakaweetamowinan
faq.seoTitle: Waniikwewiziwin Odaminoowinan gaye Ezhitwaawinan: Gagwedwewinan gaye Nakaweetamowinan
faq.description: Nakaweetamowinan gagwedwewinang gaa-onji-gagwedweng waniikwewiziwin odaminoowinan: aaniish ge-gashkitooyang, aaniin minik ge-odaminoong, ezhitwaawinan apii aakozi-aani-michaag, mino-inendamowin gaye gimoojitwaawin.
faq.lede: Dakuwaan, bagak nakaweetamowinan onji ge-naadamaagewininiwag gaa-mawiji-gagwedwewaad.

items.a: Gaa-onizhishingin odaminoowinan nagadendamowinaawan, weweni gashkitoonan, gaawiin dash gegoo mashkawinaasiin, mii go gaye gwayak ezhi-minwendang awiya noongom giizhigad. Naasab mazinaabijiganan ezhinaagwakin, baashkiziganan, wezhi'ichigewinan, gii-waawiindamang nagadendamowin-ikidowinan, zhooshkobii'igeng, gaye mazinaatese-bingo minosewag niibowa bemaadizijig. Baaga'adoosiin diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowinan, gaye gegoo ge-onji-inendang gagwedwewining.
Ahaaw. Gakina nagamowinan miinwaa ginwaabanjigewinan gaawiin bagidinaagoosiin, gaawiin akaunt, gaawiin ezhi-aanjibaawaad, gaawiin wiidookaagewin.

Dibaakwewinan miinwaa gikendamowinan ... ezhichigewin ge-ayaad gaa-mino-ganawendamaan ninaatoo ... Gaawiin ni-mino-dagoodaasiin, gaawiin ni-maajiigaasiin. Ginwaabamaa dakwaa gibiinaa ge-ganawenimigoyan ... Ezhi-giiwe igo gaawiin ...

Gakina giigoonikaaning, tablet ge-ayaang kiiwegamigong miinwaa kompyuter ge-ayaang gii-maajiiwaad ... Tablet ge-ayaang ... gaa-maajiinadaasiin ezhi-aabajitoong ... Laptop gaa-gaawiigwen TV ... miinwaa ezhi-zhaabwii gaye gaa-gikinoo'amaagewin ge-ayaang bemaadizijig.

items.q: Ambe dash ginwaabandaan bezhig ginwaabanjigewin gemaagwaan?
items.a: Ahaaw. Photo pairs ezhichigeyaan 2 miinwaa 6 ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-giiwe-gikendaman, ezhi-aanjibaawaad ezhi-gaa-goshkaadaawaad ezhi-wiinaad. Ginwaabanjigewinan ge-ayaad iwidi gwiiwizensan browser, gaawiin gaa-zhaawaad miinwaa gaawiin gaa-maajiinaawaad.

Gakina giishkaad 10 miinwaa 20 minitang gaa-dagoonaan, miinwaa niibin 2 minitang gaa-ayaawaad miikan. Ginwaabamaa ezhi-nagamowaad gaa-ganawendamaan ... Gaawiin ge-ayaa eta-gaa-gigoobii'igenan ... Ezhi-ayaa gaa-ginwaabamaan dibaakwewin.

Gaanwendam gaa-gowaad gaye ezhi-gii-agwajiwenag gaa-gikendamaan. Gaawiin gaa-ganawendamaasiin ... Ezhi-nagamowaad gaa-gowaad: gizhaagaa, gaawiin gaa-ganawenimigoosiin, gaawiin gaa-nagamowaasiin. Gaa-ganawendamaan wiigwaas-bagidinaan 'Ezhi-gii-maajiidooshkoo' gaa-aabajitoong.

Wiigiwaam miinwaa gaa-ginwaabandamaan: gaa-nagamowaad ginwaabanjigewinan miinwaa gaa-zhaabwiijiinaad ge-zhaagijigan, miinwaa gaa-zhaabwiijiinaad ezhi-gii-ganawenimigoyan. Ginwaabandaan gaye gichi-gegoo ezhi-gii-dibaakwaadaan miinwaa ezhi-ganawenimigaadaan ... Gichi-wiijiiwin gaa-gikendamaan gaa-zhiwebag ezhichigewinan ...

items.q: Ambe ezhichigewinan ge-ayaad bemaadizijig bagaajige-gegoo ezhi-ayaang?
items.a: Ahaaw. Picture bingo ezhi-ayaang ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-zhaabwii miinwaa on-screen caller, miinwaa Finish the saying miinwaa Conversation cards ezhi-zhaabwii gaa-nagamowaad. Groups guide gaa-gikendamaan gichi-bagaajige-gegoo, ezhi-dagoonaad miinwaa gaa-gikendamaan ezhi-aabajitoong.

Gaawiin ezhichigewin gaa-gikendaman gaa-ganawenimigoosiin dementia, miinwaa gaawiin gaa-nagamowaasiin ezhichigewinan ezhi-gii-dibaakwaadaan. Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii bemaadizijig gaa-ganawendang gii-aanjibaawaad miinwaa gaa-gikinoo'amaagewin gaa-agwaajiwendang, mii gaa-zhaabwii gichi-gii-ezhichigeyaan ... Gaawiin mii ezhichigewin ge-ganawenimigoosiin dementia. Ezhichigewinan gii-maajiigaanan gichi-wiijiiwin miinwaa gaa-gikendamaan.

Gaawiin ezhi-gikendamaan. Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii 14 gaa-ganawendamaan miinwaa ezhi-aabajitoong dementia gaa-zhaabwiiyaan, ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan gaa-dagoonaan, gaa-nagamowaad, gaa-bagaajige-gegoo ... Gaa-dooshkoo-ganawendamaan gaye gaawiin ezhi-gii-gikendamaasiin. Gaawiin gegoo gaa-zhichigenaan ... Gaawiin bemaadizid gaa-gii-wiijiiwin.

Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii gichi-gaawiin miinwaa gaa-nagamowin, miinwaa gaa-zhiwebag ezhi-gii-ayaad animal. Gaa-nagamowin gichi-gaawiin ezhi-gii-nagamowaad ge-gichi-gizhigaadegoyan, gaa-gikendamaan diabetes gaa-zhaabwiigan. Ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan doktor gaa-gikendaman ezhi-gii-zhichigeyaan.

Gaawiin akaunt, gaawiin zhaabwiijigewinan. Google Analytics gaa-zhaabwii gaa-dibaakwaadaan gaa-giiwe-maajiinaawaad miinwaa ezhi-gikendamaan gaa-nagamowaad ezhichigewinan. Browser gaa-zhaabwii gaa-gikendaman gaa-aanjibaawaad. Ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-giiwe-gikendaman Photo pairs gaawiin gaa-maajiinaawaad. Gikendamowin ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan gaa-zhaawaad.
Gaawiin. Golden Moments ezhichigewinan gaa-zhaabwii miinwaa gikendamowin gaa-ganawendamaan. Gaa-gikendaman gaa-zhaawaad doktor, miinwaa gaa-gigoo-maamiigonaan 911.

handout.restHtml:
Bezhig gikendamowin

  • Gaa-zhaabwii giizhigad gaa-ayaad ezhi-nagamowaad bemaadizid.
  • Gaa-zhaabwii ezhichigewin gaa-gikendamaan. Niizh-niiwin ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-ayaad.
  • Gaa-gikendamaan ginwaabanjigewinan. Dibaajimowin gaa-ayaad gichi-gikendamowin.
  • Gaa-dagoonaan gaa-nagamowaad. Gaa-dagoonaad ezhi-gii-ayaad gichi-gikendamowin.

Gaye iwidi site

  • Gaa-maajiinadaasiin: gichi-ginwaabanjigewin word search, coloring pages, conversation cards miinwaa picture bingo.
  • Ezhichigewinan gaa-ayaad gakina giizhigan, miinwaa gaa-gikendamaan ezhi-zhiwebag gaa-ezhichigeyaan miinwaa gaa-zhiwebag.

Gaa-nagamowin miinwaa dagoonaan. Gaawiin medical gikendamowin, gaawiin test, gaawiin treatment. Golden Moments gaa-maajiinadaasiin Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.shortText: {name}: diba'igasinoon, bedaatenimagakin mazinaazowin-odaminowinan gaye damitawin gikinoo'amaagewinan onji anishinaabeg e-wanitoojig minjimendamowin gaye gaa-ganawenimaajig. Gaawiin mazinazhichigesinong, gaawiin diba'igiiziswaan, gaawiin agindaasowin.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) o-migiiweman {count} diba'igasinosinonin mazinaabiki-odaminowinan gaa-ozhichigaadegin onji anishinaabeg e-wanitoojig minjimendamowin, aaniikoobii'ige-mazinaazowinan e-waabanda'ing, wenipanad bikwaakodokaajigan, baashkinigaadegin mazinaateshichiganan, kekendagaadegin ikidowinan gaye mazinaate-bingo e-gashkizhaagode-mazina'igaadeg. Gaawiin ozhibii'igazosinoon, gaawiin adaawewin dagosinoon, gaawiin diba'igiiziswaan maagizhaa agindaasowin. Owe mazina'igan gaye ayaan wenipani-ikidowin damitawin gikinoo'amaagewinan onji e-tazhi-aniki-aanjisek minjimendamowin, e-dibaajimod National Institute on Aging gaye Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: {count} mazinaabiki-odaminowinan enji-biminizhikoodemagakin oshki-mazinaabikong, tablet maagizhaa mazinaateshichiganing e-dagonamawaad kompyutar. Gaawiin atoo-mazina'igan, ozhibii'igewin maagizhaa biidaashichigewin. Waabandamok gakina odaminowinan.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Maamawi-aabaji'iganan: Mazinaate-bingo ayaawan mazina'iganan ge-gashkizhaagodegin gaye mazinaabik-ikidowini-inini, gaye wenipanad gagwedwewinan ayaawan 50 gagwedwewinan e-dagonag nakwetan gaye gegoo ji-dazhindaming.
  • Damitawin gikinoo'amaagewinan onji anokiininiwag gaye inawemaaganag, e-dagonig ezhi-ondaadizinig gaye aaniin enandawaabangak, ozhibii'igaadewan wenipani-ikidowining e-wiindamaagemagak enji-bii'amaadinig. Maajitaan omaa 101 damitawin inendamowinan maagizhaa maamawi-damitawinan onji ganawenjigewigamigoon.
organizations.restHtml:
Aaniin maamawinitijig ezhi-aabajitoodwaa

  • Ganawenjigewigamigoon gaye minjimendamowin-ganawenjigewigamigoon: mazinaate-bingo maagizhaa giizhitoon-ikidowin mawanji'idiwigamig mazinaateshichiganing, bezhig awiya e-tangishkaang onji maamawinitijig.
  • Gichi-aya'aa giizhig-anokiiwigamigoon: tablet-tasowi-danakamigad mazinaazowin-nizhichiganan niiwin mazina'iganan, onji gakina bezhig-gaye-bezhig anama'ewin.
  • Oodena-agindaasowigamigoon: mazina'igaadegin ikidowin-nandawaabam gaye gaganoonidiwin-mazina'iganan biinjayi'i minjimendamowin mashkimoding, gaye owe mazinaateshichigan e-atoodwaa agindaasowigamig tablets.
  • Gaa-ganawenimaajig wiidookoodaadiwigamigoon gaye minjimendamowin-wiisiniwigamigoon: bezhigobii'igan ge-gashkizhaagodeg mazina'igan onji inawemaaganag ji-giiwewidoowaad.
  • Aakoziwigamigoon gaye giiwewin-waawindamogeg: mazina'igan biinjayi'i gaa-ganawenimaajig mashkimoding, onji bekaadisichigewin endanaaniwang maagizhaa nibaaganing.

Wegonen gaa-inaabadizisinook

Odaminowinan ondaadiziwag ji-minawaanigoziying gaye ji-maamawi-ayaaying. Gaawiin aakoziwin o-mikawanzinoon, gagwedwewin ozhichigesinoon, agindaasowin dagonzinosinoon, noochimasinoon maagizhaa gaawiin bekaadizisinoon minjimendamowin-aanjisek, gaye gigagwedwemin anokiiwigamigoon gego iwi ezhi-dibaajimookegon. Gaawiin adaawewinan dagosinoon, gaye odaminowinan gaawiin gagwedwesinoon izhinikaazowinan, mino-bimaadiziwin dibaajimowinan maagizhaa mazinaabiki-mazinaazowinan ji-onda'amowaad. Owe mazina'igan o-doodaan Google Analytics ji-agindang bizaanyewinan; gidinwewinan giiwanimo-mazina'igan o-dibaadaan wegonen e-maamawinigaadeg. Mazinaazowinan e-aabajitoodwaa omaa Mazinaazowin-niizhooshichiganan ganawenjigaadewan biinjayi'i mazinaabikong.

Dagonamawishinaam gidinaakonigewin-mazina'iganing

Kishpin ayaaman mazina'igan onji gaa-ganawenimaajig, gigichi-inendagoz ji-aaniikoobii'iyan omaa {domain}. Gidaa-naasabiibii'aan awe-gaye-awe dibaajimowin.
organizations.linksHtml:
Gwayak mazina'iganan ge-aaniikoobii'igaadegin: diba'igasinoon odaminowinan, diba'igasinoon ge-gashkizhaagodegin, damitawinan onji Alzheimer's gaye aaniin waa-ezhi-maamawi-odaminoying.

Gagwedwewinan maagizhaa gwayakochigewinan

Kishpin gegoo ooma mazina'iganing mayaamajiwag maagizhaa gaawiin ningoting nisidotanagisinook, maagizhaa gaa-daajig gego inaabadizisiwag wegonen e-tegin omaa, maajiibii'amawishinaam omaa {email}. Daga gego maajiibii'angegon wiinigo aawiyan maagizhaa mino-bimaadiziwin dibaajimowin onji gaa-daajig maagizhaa e-wiidookawaajig.

app.title: Golden Moments App
app.seoTitle: Golden Moments App onji iPhone gaye Android
app.description: Diba'igasinoo Golden Moments app: bedaatenimagak mazinaazowin-nizhichigan niiwin mishi-mazina'iganan, inawemaaganag mazinaazowinan ganawenjigaadewan gidoonaaganikong, nibiina mazinaazowin-mashkimodaan gaye gaawiin ozhibii'igazosinoon.
app.lede: Gakina gegoo menwendaman omaa mazina'iganing, biinjayi'i app anokiimagad gego aaniikoobii'isig gaye gidaa-aabajitoonan inawemaaganag mazinaazowinan gaa-onapinamowan.
app.bodyHtml:
Pangi madaanii

Niiwin mangi-mazina'iganensan gaye mazinaakiziganan gaa-nagadendamingin madaanii. Ganawaabandamook mazinaakiziganan ji-naabaminagwadinig, maagizhaa gidinawaan giishpin iji-minwendameg. Bangan-odaaminowin gaawiin diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowin maagizhaa angoziwin ayaasinoon. Onapidon 4, 6, 8 maagizhaa 12 mazina'iganensan.

Gidoodeminaan da-inendaagwad

Onapidon enawemadwaa omazinaakiziganiwaan omaa gaa-aabajitooyan. App odashtoon agaasaagin mazinaakiziganan ji-aabajitoong odaaminowining. Gaawiin andawaabandanzinoon gakina gaa-ateg maagizhaa ji-aanjitood gi-mazinaakiziganiwaan, gaye gashkitoomagad ji-ganawendang miziwe eta 24 mazinaakiziganan bezhigong.

Mawandoodaa ganawaabandang

Bezhig eta mazinaakizigan pezhigong ganawaabandan. Gagwedwewinensan noonde-gagwe-gaganonidiing, gaawiin awiya gagwejimasiin ji-mikitood wiinzo-mazinaate maagizhaa ji-gwayakwendang. Eta ganawaabandaming debise.

Aabadan misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon

Madaa-mazinaakiziganan gaye gakina nishwaaswi mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan dagoshinoon omaa app-ing. Mazinaakiziganan gaa-biindigadooyeg aabadanoon misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon. Mazinaakiziganan gaa-ategin iCloud eta maagizhaa odaapinamang internet ji-gashkitoong.

Gaawiin ozhibii'iganens, gaawiin gaye asanjigewigamig

Gidoodem mazinaakiziganan atewan omaa app-ing gaa-aabajitooyan. Gidaa-aangoshkaan iniw mazinaakiziganan gaawiin dash ji-wanaajitoodan gaa-oshki-mazinaakiziganan. Gaa-aabajitooyan gaa-ganawendaming maagizhaa dagoshinomaa app-wiindamaagewinan. Agindan app privacy policy, gaye app help wiindamaagemagad aaniin ji-izhitood pangi eta.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments aabadan ji-minwendaming gaye ji-gaganonidiing. Gaawiin onji-nanaandawi'iwesinoon, gaawiin odino-noojitoosinoon, gaawiin ogiba'anzinoon, gaye gaawiin odibaabandanzinoon wanishkweyendamowin maagizhaa Alzheimer’s aakoziiwin.

Gaawiin ozhibii'igewin, diba'igiiziswaan maagizhaa agindasowin.

faq.a: Mazinaakizigan-niizhodewag niiwin mazina'iganensan bangan-madaa-onapidamowin aawan. Giishpin mazinaakiziganan onaabandang sanagad aawan, gagwejitoodaa Mikaw bezhigo-mazinaakizigan niizhin mazinichiganing. Niibina giishpin ayawaad, gagwejitoodaa Mazinaakizigan-bingo.

faq.q: Aabadanoon na iniw odaaminowinan omaa iPad maagizhaa giigidowining?
faq.a: Enya. Endaso-odaaminowin aabadan omaa browser giigidowining, tablets gaye mazinaabik-asiganing, gaye mazinaakiziganan mangishkaamagadoon ji-moshkinebiig mazinaateshiganing. Tablet asanjigaadeg ganabatash naawiji-minwendang niizh awiya.

faq.q: Onizhishinoon na owe odaaminowinan awiya wenji-wanendang Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Enya. Ozhichigaadewan aabajitoowaad wenji-wanishkwendangig, gaye a’aw wenji-wanendang Alzheimer’s, gaa-maamawi-michaag. Mazinaakiziganan naabaminagwadoon, pangi eta atewan onapidamowinan, gaye gaawiin gegoo diba'igiizisowaasiin maagizhaa agindaswaasiin, mii dash iniw odaaminowinan aabajitoong ji-kikendaming nagadendamingin kakina gaawiin dash oshki-mikwendamowin.

Nandawaabamidiwin gaye mazinaakizigan-odaaminowinan aawanoon gaa-minwendang gichi-aya'aa, ambe dash gaawiin ozhichigaadesinoon ji-gwaashkwezitood mikwendamowin: omaa Mazinaakizigan-niizhodewag mazinaakiziganan naabaminagwadoon eta giishpin bakaan inendaman. Niwiindamaagowinaan mikwendamoo-odaaminowinan gichi-aya'aag wenji-wanishkwendangig wiindamaagemagad aaniin ji-izhi-banganaag endaso-mikwendamoo-odaaminowin.

faq.q: Ayawan na odaaminowinan maamawi-aabajitoowaad aaniindi ganawenindiwaad?
faq.a: Enya. Mazinaakizigan-bingo ayaamagad mazina'iganensan ji-mooka'ang gaye mazinigewin mazinaateshiganing, gaye Giizhitaa ikidowin gaye Gaganonidiwin-mazina'iganensan mino-aabadanoon aagindan enjibaamagag maamawi.

gameFaqNo.a: Gaawiin omaa odaminowining. O'ow Golden Moments aabajichiganens gaa-diba'igaadesinook ji-aabajitood iPhone, iPad gaye Android gego dagonoozoosiwan, bekaaji-aanikoobidoon mangishaaniwan mazinaakizonan gaye gidoo-deshkan-inawemaaganag o-mazinaakizowiniwaan gaa-onaabandaman, gaye anokiimagad misawaa gaawiin Wi‑Fi ayasinook. O'ow odaminowin apane bizhishigwago giga-odamin omaa gidaabajichigan-waakaa'iganing.

gamePage.noscript: O'ow odaminowin nandawendam JavaScript ji-biindigenaagwad omaa gidaabajichiganing. Odoo-gikinoo'amaagewinan omaa naamiing anokiimagadoon misawaa gaawiin atezinoog.
gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Oshki-odaminowin ina awiya e-ani-wanitood o-mikwendamowin gaa-wiidji-odaminimad? Agindan aaniin eji-maamawii-odaminoong, miinawaa aaniin ge-todaman giishpin booni-minwendang.
gamePage.appText: O'ow Golden Moments aabajichiganens gaa-diba'igaadesinook bekaaji-aanikoobidoon mangishaaniwan mazinaakizonan gaye gi-bezhigoog-inawemaaganag o-mazinaakizowiniwaan, gaye anokiimagad misawaa gaawiin Wi‑Fi ayasinook. iPhone, iPad miinawaa Android.
gamePage.photoAppText: Imaa Golden Moments aabajichiganensing gaa-diba'igaadesinook, mazinaakizonan gaa-onaabandaman apane ategomaa imaa gidaabajichiganing ji-aabajitooyan miinawaa, gaye odaminowinan anokiimagadoon misawaa gaawiin Wi‑Fi ayasinook. iPhone, iPad miinawaa Android.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: O'ow odaminowin gaa-ojichigaadeg ji-minwendaming miinawaa ji-maamawii-ayaang. Gaawiin gegoo ogwejitoosiin, odibaabandanziin, maagizhaa onooji'isiinan.
